name: Anirit Ventures Limited
about: Anirit Ventures Limited engages in trading, marketing, and handling of agricultural products, minerals, and energy resources in India. The company also promotes agricultural and non-agricultural ventures, including agritourism, agri-tech, infrastructure, agri biogas, and related businesses. In addition, it invests in businesses engages in the scientific research. The company was formerly known as Flora Textiles Limited and changed its name to Anirit Ventures Limited in December 2024. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India. Anirit Ventures Limited operates as a subsidiary of OilMax Energy Pvt. Ltd.
